confidencePolicy: Confidence measures evidence quality, quantity, independence, and degree of verification. It is not subjective belief strength.
linkedDecisionPolicy: linkedDecision is a Decision/Case id string or null. Do not embed Decision, decisionHistory, or Playbook fields.
evidencePolicy: supportingEvidence and contradictingEvidence store Evidence references only. Evidence values remain in data/evidence/.
researchPolicy: linkedResearch stores Research Card references only. Card content remains in research/{id}/card.json.
